people.name: Hananiah
people.line: Son of Heman, a musician in David's time

translations.web: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

translations.kjv: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
